title: Browsermc
description: Want to browse the web in game? Try this modpack!!

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/abcbb3caf1bc8b6ef6e33205b9aedbd4aefd7a08_0.webp)



**'Browsermc'** is a new modpack that brings the internet to your Minecraft client! find things on the web, watch content, look at social media, and more—all without leaving the game. Whether you're looking up crafting recipes, watching tutorials, or just browsing for fun, **Browsermc** makes it possible right from your in-game screen.

> 🔹 Core Features
> 
> ✔️ In-game web browser integration
> 
> ✔️ Support for basic browsing (search, websites, etc.)
> 
> ✔️ Ability to watch videos in-game
> 
> ✔️ Interactive UI with clickable links
